title: Spicy Indian Bliss Chutney
description: A tangy and spicy condiment made with bliss, garlic, and gherkin, perfect for Indian snacks.
instructions: Roast the garlic cloves in a pan over low heat until soft.
Blend the roasted garlic, bliss, and gherkin into a smooth paste.
Add a pinch of salt and mix well.
Adjust the seasoning according to taste.
Transfer the chutney to a serving bowl and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
Serve with Indian snacks or as a side dish.
